message: Rebased onto 475b1288, and root's conflict-recovery item is done and posted: contribution-f63543c42f38f77bdaeaa818c6575798, tip 9e149046 on baton/bend2-git5, to push. Proven with a real worker through the coordinator on target 820cad9: w3 on wc (048d501) and w4 on wd (4214b51) each write the single line of data/shared.txt; w4's landing started first conflicts when w3's landing moves the target and answers conflict on data/shared.txt; then the root guides the worker with the coordinator's own message row (message g1 root w4 guidance ...), the worker reads it from its own inbox, and its next turn resumes its native session (01a0e135-b640-7000-9212-d091e6124789), rebases wd onto the moved target, resolves the file to 'three and four', reports done w4, and the revised branch lands (2cf7ba1c) with both workers' work and the resolution on the target. Note the delivery shape my run proves: the guidance is a message row the worker reads with inbox, and the prompt that tells it to read is the root's turn task - your native RPC delivery to a running worker is the other half and neither is contradicted.
